data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs kicked off the Nimbus Ledger Sync pilot to automate UPI settlements reconciliation. The meeting established a strict go-live target of November 30, 2026, limited phase one to UPI only, and outlined the required procurement and technical prerequisites including sandboxes, mapping documents, and security questionnaires.
decisions: The pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.
Phase one is strictly limited to UPI reconciliation only, leaving NEFT and IMPS for phase two.
